title: Sealing of the Spirit
definition: The sealing of the Spirit means that God marks believers as His own and guarantees their inheritance in Christ.
summary: The Spirit is God's seal of ownership and pledge of future redemption. Believers are secure because salvation rests on God's promise, not their own strength.
christFocus: The sealing of the Spirit confirms that believers belong to Christ and will be brought safely to their final inheritance.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit is God's seal of ownership and pledge of future redemption. Believers are secure because salvation rests on God's promise, not their own strength.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
